name: Quarterly Estimates of GDP
timing: End of Feb, May, Aug and Nov (approx. T+2 months)
description: Press note with GDP, GVA by industry and expenditure components for the latest quarter, at current and constant prices, with year-on-year growth.

name: First Advance Estimates of Annual GDP
description: First estimate of GDP for the ongoing financial year, used for Union Budget preparation.

name: Second Advance Estimates of Annual GDP
description: Revised estimate for the ongoing financial year, released with Q3 estimates and revisions of earlier years.

name: Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP
description: Estimate for the just-completed financial year, released with Q4 quarterly estimates.

name: Revised Estimates of National Income
description: First, Second and Third Revised Estimates for earlier years, incorporating fuller source data.

name: National Accounts Statistics (NAS)
description: The annual flagship publication: detailed statements on aggregates, industry-wise GVA, capital formation, saving, institutional sector accounts, and consumption by purpose.

name: State Domestic Product (GSDP/NSDP)
description: State-wise GSDP, NSDP and per-capita income at current and constant prices, compiled with State DES.

name: Supply and Use Tables / Input-Output Tables
description: Product-by-industry tables describing the structure of production and use in the economy.

name: Sources and Methods of National Accounts
description: Methodology document describing data sources, coverage and compilation methods for every sector and aggregate.

name: Advance Release Calendar
description: MoSPI's calendar of scheduled release dates for national accounts and other statistical products.
